_: story encounters (the list of 2026-11-20's fifteenth phase, idea 8; 941_stories15.py): the encounter director's roaming kinds that play a story (C++ RD/RDList15n.cpp). kinds: name, title (who they are), story (courier, chased, cart, rival), weight against the director's other kinds, folk (a townsfolk def's name: the person), text (their lines split by |: the chased's and the carter's first is their plea, the rest after), gift (Item|min|max|chance joined by ;) and gold, place (the rival's: the points of interest one is laid from). letters: a courier's letter ({hero} her hero). rival: her rival's name, body and lines.

kinds.name: roam_story_chased
kinds.title: a fleeing traveller
kinds.text: Help! They're right behind me!|You saved my life. Take this, it's all I have.|I'll not travel this road alone again.

kinds.name: roam_story_cart
kinds.title: a stranded carter
kinds.text: The wheel's off and I can't lift her alone. Lend a hand?|Bless you! Here, for your trouble.|She'll hold to the next town, I reckon.

letters: I heard what you did on the road. If you pass my way again, the kettle is on. Here is a little something.
Word travels. They say {hero} clears the wilds of beasts. Keep safe, and take this for your trouble.
You helped me once and I have not forgotten. This should keep you on your feet.

rival.name: Varka the Swift
rival.hello: Another treasure-seeker? Then we race. Whatever lies ahead is mine.
rival.again: You again! Race you to it.
rival.won: Ha! Too slow. Better luck next time.
rival.lost: Curse your legs! Next time, it's mine.
